title: Starting on guitar in the number two band; no musical family
summary: Robinson lists his band's members, says he started on guitar, and that nobody else in his family played music.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up a first guitar or banjo, self-taught

blocks.x: Who else was in your band?
Who else? My band was... My band was... We... Consist of a fellow by the name of Shield Table... Let's see... Shield guy. He used to play trombone.
Well, what instrument did you start in?
I started a guitar. That's what I'm coming up to. I started a guitar. That's when I was in the country.

With a shield table, trombone, a fellow by the name of Bud Green. He was on drums. Joe Banks was on cornet. Little Willie, well, he was playing clarinet in our band at them times. And I was guitar. And a little fellow by the name of Alfred Dixon. He was playing bass.
We didn't have no violin in our...
Before I forget it, did your father, mother, anyone in your family play music before you?
Did you have any brothers or older brothers or sisters? Anyone that played music?
None of them played music. I'm the only one.
Excuse the introduction. Go ahead and tell about your band if there's anything else you can tell about the type of music they played. They played for dances.
Yeah. That's what I was dancing.
